claims.text: Topical corticosteroid (eg, prednisolone acetate 1%) is often given with a mydriatic to reduce inflammation and scarring; evidence not definitive
claims.quote: Mydriatic drops (eg, scopolamine 0.25% or atropine 1%) and topical corticosteroids (eg, prednisolone acetate 1%) are often given to reduce inflammation and scarring. However, the evidence to support the use of mydriatics and corticosteroids for hyphema is not definitive
